note: A final segment matching a builtin. Stricter than collision-avoidance needs, and deliberately so: it removes the ambiguity the closed enum exists to remove, and defeats host-side suffix matching.
schema_divergence: JSON Schema cannot express "the final segment must not be one of the ten builtin names" without a lookahead that would make the pattern unreadable for the one rule it adds. The loader enforces it (INVALID-ASSET-CLASS-002).
